test_case.test_name: DF IOM watchdog SyncFlood reset and durable-source correlation
test_case.purpose: For each approved socket/IOM, inject one authoritative watchdog fault, prove a fresh SyncFlood-driven reset and IOM-specific durable CPER/BERT record, then restore fabric I/O and all settings.
required_package: IOM-specific CPER/BERT source and reset/boot timing
OOB boot/reimage, DF-I/O recovery and exact rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not inject or clear status. After approval, preserve prior forensic evidence, capture raw threshold/reset-cause state, use only the documented clear/readback sequence if authorized, inject one mapped IOM once under OOB capture, correlate fresh transition and CPER through boot, then restore and verify every DF-attached path.
test_case.expected_result: The intended IOM source produces the signed SyncFlood/reset branch; reset-cause evidence transitions freshly and one new IOM-specific durable record appears; firmware/OS and all fabric I/O recover within deadlines with exact configuration/status restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until flag/register/reset semantics are authoritative. SyncFlood=1 alone, generic watchdog text, stale BERT, wrong source, missing/unexpected reset, boot failure, I/O loss or improper cleanup fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and reimage path.
Preserve evidence before any approved W1C/clear.
One socket/IOM once; abort on wrong source, boot loop, missing record or persistent I/O fault.
expected_evidence: Single injection and OOB reset/boot timeline
Fresh IOM-specific CPER/BERT and SyncFlood transition
Recovered DF I/O and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Define absent/unexpected reset, boot-loop/reimage, sticky-status cleanup and all DF-attached device recovery while restoring threshold, Platform First, FCH and HDT state. Execution remains blocked until approved.
